status: Existing snapshot categorization; allocation stacks/query text not captured for native query entries
method: Aggregate snapshot self bytes by serialized type/name; walk all strong outgoing edges from every native MediaQuerySet; no new browser execution.
limits: Snapshot self-byte totals include native allocations and are not an exact reconciliation to CDP JSHeapUsedSize.
Query trees do not encode native C++ query text as JavaScript strings in these captures; presence of a bundle string is not an allocation trace.
Named group deltas and retaining paths cannot alone identify original allocation stacks or prove growth benign/leaking.
